articles.summary: Invitation Homes Inc. (NYSE: INVH) (“Invitation Homes” or the “Company”), the nation’s premier single-family home leasing and management company, today announced that M. Colin Connolly, President, Chief Executive Officer, and Director of Cousins Properties Incorporated (“Cousins”) has been appointed to the Company’s board of directors (the “Board”), effective November 13, 2026. Mr. Connolly, who the Board has determined is independent, will serve on the Compensation and Management Development Committee and the Investment and Finance Committee. His appointment increases the size of the Board to ten members. “Colin brings a fresh perspective from leading another public REIT through multiple market cycles,” said Michael Fascitelli, Chairperson of the Board. “His leadership and vast real estate experience will strengthen the Board’s discussions, and we are pleased to welcome him.” “As a sitting REIT CEO, Colin offers deep, practical expertise in capital allocation, real estate investment,
articles.title: Invitation Homes Announces Addition of M. Colin Connolly to Board of Directors
